scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @school-crm/api && node --test apps/api/test/*.test.cjs apps/web/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @school-crm/api && npm run build --workspace @school-crm/web
